findings.title: website_name bypasses TL0 field hiding
findings.body: include_website_name is never consulted: ActiveModel::Serializer only calls include_website_name?. website_name is also missing from untrusted_attributes, unlike website. Anonymous viewers of a TL0 user therefore still get website_name (host, and host+path when it matches the instance), which is the same profile URL the serializer is supposed to withhold. The new specs never cover a TL0/anonymous viewer, so this leak is untested.

findings.title: Same-domain path display fails on case and www
findings.body: Hosts are compared case-sensitively and without normalizing a leading www. A site at example.com will not treat http://Example.com/user or http://www.example.com/user as the same domain (lengths differ, and example.com does not end with .www.example.com), so the profile shows only the host. The inverse (instance on www, website on the apex) does append the path, so the feature is inconsistent with its own parent-domain rule. Comparisons should downcase both hosts and treat a single www label as equivalent before deciding whether to append the path.
